p. p. [तुष् कर्तरि क्त] 
__1 Pleased, satisfied, delighted, gratified, contented.

-ष्टः N. of Viṣṇu.

f. [तुष्-भावे-क्तिन्] 
__1 Satisfaction, gratification, pleasure, contentment. 
__2 (In Sāṅ. phil.) Acquiescence, indifference to everything except what is possessed.
